title: chore: bump objectui to latest (94d4876) — @objectstack/console major
body:
## What

Refreshes the pinned Console SPA (`@object-ui/console`) to objectui `origin/main` (`94d4876df090`), up from `fd45313b4d00`.

- `.objectui-sha` → `94d4876df0900c7eeec002bf61ebb2a849daea8c`
- Adds `@objectstack/console` changeset marked **`major`**.

## objectui range `fd45313b4d00...94d4876df090`

- feat(dashboard): Studio authors the ADR-0021 dataset shape only (framework#3251) (objectui#2703)
- feat(app-shell): render ActionParamDialog params through the shared form field-widget renderer (objectui#2700, ADR-0059) (objectui#2704)
- feat(app-shell): distinguish writable system objects from engine-owned in badge + empty-state (ADR-0103 / #3220) (objectui#2705)
- fix(list): keep injected owner_id out of leading auto-derived list columns (objectui#2702)
- feat(flow-designer): #2670 Phase 3 — nested container node selection + schema-driven editing (objectui#2699)
- feat(approvals-inbox): retire hardcoded secondary buttons for server-declared actions (objectui#2697)

## ⚠️ Major bump — whole-stack blast radius

`@objectstack/console` is in the Changesets **fixed (lockstep) group of 73 packages**, so a `major` bump promotes the **entire platform** (currently `15.1.1` → `16.0.0`) on the next release. The `allow-major` label is applied so the launch-window **Check Changeset** gate passes.
